sentences.text: This is an application under Section 438 of the CrPC filed by the petitioner Zahidul Ali praying for anticipatory bail in connection with Uriamghat P.S. Case No.38/2023, registered under Sections 376/506/427 of the IPC.

One married woman has alleged in the FIR that she was maintaining relationship with the present petitioner and the petitioner had taken some nude photographs and has been threatening her to publish those photographs on social media.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 of the CrPC, the woman has stated that she was in love with the present petitioner.
About one year ago, she had gone to Bokajan with the present petitioner where the petitioner allegedly had forceful sexual intercourse with her.
According to woman, the petitioner was interested to continue his affair with her.
After hearing the learned counsels of both sides, this Court is of the opinion that it was consensual physical relationship.
Therefore, the petitioner Zahidul Ali does not deserve to be detained in custody.
Accordingly, his pre-arrest bail application is allowed.

The petitioner Zahidul Ali is allowed to go on bail connection with Uriamghat P.S. Case No.38/2023, registered under Sections 376/506/427 of the IPC on furnishing bail bond of 20,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
Page No.# 3/3 The bail application is disposed of.
